response.original_title: Can I add a passenger to my Carnival Cruise?
response.overview: Yes, you can add a passenger to an existing Carnival Cruise booking by calling Carnival Customer Service at 1-855-CARNIVAL (1-855-732-4023) or contacting your travel agent. You cannot make this change online or through the mobile app.  Requirements for Adding a Guest  Stateroom Capacity: Your current room must have the physical capacity to hold an extra person (for example, a room built for up to four guests).  Ship Capacity: The overall ship and lifeboat limits must not be reached.  Pricing and Fees: Adding a passenger may cause your booking to be re-priced at current market rates, and change fees could apply.  Information Needed: Have your current booking number ready, along with the new passenger's full legal name and date of birth.
